reason: Akebia sells therapeutic drugs for kidney disease (FDA-approved renal products) to dialysis and nephrology customers. Lantheus is a radiopharmaceutical company focused on diagnostic imaging agents (PYLARIFY, DEFINITY, Cardiolite) sold to hospitals, imaging centers and radiopharmacies, and it is only now moving into radiotherapeutics. The products differ (renal therapeutics vs. imaging diagnostics) and so do the buyers and the clinical area. The only common ground is that both are FDA-regulated branded pharma companies, which is not enough for a peer.
